weapon_synth_sound_engine89 v1.9.0 i386 report

Result: NOT COMPLETED IN THIS CONTAINER.

The compiler accepted initial -m32 translation units, then stopped when a
header included <limits.h> and the host could not find:

  bits/libc-header-start.h

This is the same missing glibc multilib development-header limitation observed
in earlier releases. It is an environment/toolchain limitation, not a C89
compiler diagnostic produced by the new DSP code. Native strict-C89 builds,
all runtime tests and ASan/UBSan validation passed.
